_note: Enemy definitions. attacks: first key is the teaching attack (the first two turns), then a random pick.

aswang.name: CORRUPTED ASWANG
aswang.opening: Rusted iron screams overhead. The Aswang drops into the alley, and the lamps die.
aswang.victory: The Aswang comes apart into thick, oily smoke. Rain washes the alley clean of it.

claw.name: Claw
claw.text: The Aswang rakes the air, claws low.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.text: The Aswang coils, every rib showing... and LUNGES.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.text: It whirls into a blur of claws. Three strikes, one breath.

aevum_hound.name: AEVUM HOUND
aevum_hound.opening: The safehouse lights die. Something with too many legs and one red lens drops through the skylight: an Aevum hound.
aevum_hound.victory: The hound's lens cracks. It spits sparks, then goes quiet, and its telemetry tag stops blinking.

jab.name: Jab
jab.text: The hound's forelegs stab down like pistons.

net.name: Net
net.text: A weighted net spits from its belly. Duck it or be dragged.

burst.name: Burst
burst.text: Its chassis whines. Three quick shots from the lens.

collector_goon.name: VALDEZ'S COUSIN
collector_goon.opening: The cousin cracks his knuckles and sets his feet on the wet curb. He has done this before.
collector_goon.victory: The cousin sits down hard in a puddle and decides he is not paid enough.

shove.name: Shove
shove.text: He drops a shoulder and shoves.

swing.name: Swing
swing.text: A wide haymaker, wound up like a bad decision.

combo.name: Combo
combo.text: Jab, jab, and an elbow he learned from television.

tiyanak.name: TIYANAK
tiyanak.opening: The crying stops. Something small and wrong uncurls from the drain, and smiles with too many teeth.
tiyanak.victory: The tiyanak shrieks, shrinks, and unspools into a damp scrap of baby blanket. The drain is quiet.

cry.name: Cry
cry.text: A wail that makes your hands forget what they were doing.

scratch.name: Scratch
scratch.text: Two quick swipes, faster than something that small should be.

leap.name: Leap
leap.text: It coils, and leaps for your face.
